notes: Seed URL www.vctxelections.org redirects to www.victoriacountytx.gov (Elections pages). Clarity elections.json does not list 2024 or 2026 elections, so EIDs were taken from the county's own links: Election Results page links 'Election Night Reporting - Unofficial Results 8:51 pm' to results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Victoria/126376/ (May 26, 2026 runoff) and 'Election Night Reporting' to /126049/ (March 3, 2026 primary); the Elections Historical Archive links 'November 5, 2024 Joint General Election: Election Returns' to /122848/. Check 1 read every readable update for each (some versions returned HTTP 404). Nonzero precinct vote cells rise across election-night updates, showing election-day votes added during the night. Check 3 not needed.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LIVE by check 1 (precinct numbers in 5, 3 and 3 election-night Clarity updates), so the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with confidence high.

2024_general.fact: Clarity update log EID 122848: election-night versions at 7:53, 8:17, 8:35, 8:51 and 9:56 PM CST each have 35 precincts with nonzero candidate votes; nonzero precinct vote cells 2886, 4281, 4379, 4395, 4402.

2026_primary.fact: Clarity update log EID 126049: election-night versions at 8:12, 8:58 and 9:38 PM CST each have 35 precincts with nonzero candidate votes; nonzero cells 8965, 13614, 14030.

2026_runoff.fact: Clarity update log EID 126376: election-night versions at 7:19, 8:07 and 8:48 PM CDT each have 35 precincts with nonzero candidate votes; nonzero cells 363, 685, 1119.
